case.title: 03:00Z equals 06:00 Nairobi exactly and must not fire

submissions.open_text: Handle is stiff so children cannot draw water alone.
Pressure drops after lunch and the storage tank empties.

case.why: 03:00:00Z converts to exactly 06:00:00+03:00. That is not before 06:00, so off_hours must stay silent. This case tests offset conversion and the exclusive morning bound together. An implementation reading the raw hour (03) fires wrongly. So does one that converts correctly but compares with <= 06:00. Other checks are quiet. Participant durations are 480 s and 540 s, both at least 180 s. same_spot never applies to participants. There are 2 submissions, fewer than 5. Points (-0.100, 34.752) and (-0.104, 34.746) are inside Nyalenda. The texts share no content words, and there is no voice note.
